summary: Native CountGems 400 Blue (step 0) -> Dispel/TrueDamage -> ExplodeGems 1 (last step). R001 needs the damage before the explosion, but its boost is 'Blue Gems destroyed' by that later explosion; no modifier source previews the gems a later clear segment will destroy (destroyedGems only sees earlier segments, boardGems counts the whole board). Needs a primitive (pre-resolved explode cells / deferred clear) or a ruling that native CountGems counts the whole board. Prototype currently explodes first (skull damage lands before the spell damage).
repro: npx vite-node scripts/gow-golden.ts show --keys troop:6398  (L10: explode 9 ; skulls E10 1 ; dmg E11 18)

summary: ConvertGems@FromTarget FromTarget>DaemonicPortal [AddForKill 1]: after the kill the defeated enemy is removed from state.teams, so gems.ts resolveColor('LAST_TARGET'/'CHOSEN_TARGET') finds no character and converts nothing. Needs the target's mana colours captured before death (castTracking snapshot) so 'their Mana Color' resolves for a dead target.
repro: npx vite-node scripts/gow-golden.ts show --keys troop:7597  (K: dmg E11 14 ; defeat E11 ; no convert)

summary: Note for sa-P (already queued as P-counter-per-step): 8228 native has two Count steps, CountAttackArmorLife 50 (one step over Attack+Armor+Life) and CountMagic 50. Prototype lists four targetStat sources; per-source flooring would floor Attack, Armor and Life separately, which is still not native. Needs grouped sources (or a sum-of-stats source) so each native step floors once.
repro: npx vite-node scripts/gow-golden.ts show --keys troop:6826  (L10 dmg E11 482; native floor(927/2)+floor(11/2)+13 = 481)

summary: tests/helpers/gowCast.ts leaks state between casts: DEFAULT_ALLIES[0].statuses and the shared `ench` array of DEFAULT_ENEMIES E10/E13 are passed by reference into damageCharacter, and status pushes mutate them. After troop:6025 (Barrier on A1) every later cast in the same process starts with A1 Barrier, so scenarioLines/golden replays depend on key order (gowCastGolden fails for L4b troop:6355, troop:6265, L4a troop:6623 when run after other keys). Fix: deep-copy statuses (and every default object) in setupCast. sa-F2 approved each of its keys in a separate process (uncontaminated lines).
repro: npx vite-node -e: castSpell({key:'troop:6025'}); then DEFAULT_ALLIES[0].statuses contains barrier; castSpell({key:'troop:6355'}) shows 'remove A1 -barrier'
